place: the dark ocean floor, a lone black internet cable running across the sand
the cable beside a green garden hose

moments.what: marine snow drifts down over the dark sand, the cable already lit
the cable's label writes on
pulses of light race along the cable's glowing seam
a width bracket snaps across the cable
a green garden hose slides in beside it, the same width
a label writes on the hose

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: This internet cable is as wide as a garden hose.

params.place: the same seabed, the cable's cut end

moments.what: pulses of light stream faster along the cable, a label writes on
the camera swings round to the cable's cut end
light glows out of the cut end

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: How does the internet fit inside it?

params.place: the cable's cut end, sliced open in a cutaway

moments.what: a glowing cut ring sweeps along the cable
the outer jacket peels back in a cutaway
the camera pushes in on the cut face as the layers light up one by one from the outside in
the outer rings glow and fade
the rings separate slightly, exploded
a bundle of glass fibres at the centre lights up cyan
a label writes on: glass fibres
one fibre slides forward out of the bundle
a strand of human hair slides in beside the fibre
a label writes on the hair, the two match

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Slice it open. Past its protective layers sit glass fibres, each about as thin as a human hair.

params.place: inside one glass fibre, a glowing tunnel of glass

moments.what: a tiny phone screen frame turns into a pulse of light at the fibre's mouth
the pulse shoots into the glass tunnel
a train of flashes follows, on and off
the tunnel lights up cyan
the light zigzags, bouncing off the glass walls
the walls flash where the light hits them
the camera rides along the fibre
the camera pulls far out: the fibre is a thin glowing line on the seabed
the line reaches a far shore glowing in the distance

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Your video races down one as flashes of light, bouncing off the glass walls from one continent to the next.

params.place: the Earth from space, its oceans laced with glowing cables

moments.what: the camera rises off the seabed to the whole planet, one cable glowing on it
more cables draw on across the Atlantic
the kilometre counter beside the globe, counting since the line began, lands
cables draw on across the Pacific
the globe turns
landing points light up on the coasts
every landing point flashes
the second figure writes on a plate below the globe
more cables draw on around Africa and Asia
the lit cables pulse
dashed planned cables draw on

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: And it is not alone. Over 1.5M kilometres of cable cross the seabed, with more than 600 cables working or planned.

params.place: the seabed in murky light, an anchor chain coming down

moments.what: murky green seabed: a trawl net's boards and mesh lie on the sand, a ship's hull shadow passes above
the camera drifts past the net toward the cable
sand swirls in a current
a crack mark flickers on the cable
the pulses stutter
the camera drifts along the cable
the trawl net in the distance sweeps in over the seabed
the net's heavy doors scrape the sand
a ship's hull passes far above
a huge anchor drops into the sand
the anchor drags toward the cable, sand flying
the anchor snags the cable and it snaps, the light dies at the break

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: But down here, what keeps breaking them? Mostly fishing gear and ship anchors dragged across the cable.

params.place: the open ocean at dusk, a cable repair ship on the waves

moments.what: a cable repair ship rides the swell
its deck lights come on
a line from its bow winch hauls the cable up out of the water
the broken end dangles, dark
the second end comes up beside it
both ends land on the lit deck
the camera pushes in on a splice box where two fibres meet
a spark flashes where the glass fuses
light runs through the joined fibre again

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: So a repair ship lifts the broken ends onto its deck and joins the glass back together.

params.place: the globe again at night, one cable flashing red

moments.what: a fault counter on the globe's ring starts ticking up
the counter lands on the figure
one cable flashes red
a red break mark pulses on it
red sparks flicker at breaks around the globe
the camera pulls back to the whole planet
a pulse of light sets off from one coast
the pulse reaches the red break
the pulse keeps glowing
the pulse turns off the broken cable
it races along a different cable
it reaches the far coast, the new path glowing gold

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Roughly 200 times a year, a cable breaks somewhere. Yet your video keeps playing, because the data takes another cable.

params.place: high in the water over the seabed, then down to the cable on the ocean floor

moments.what: high over the dark seabed, the cable and rocks below, the surface glowing above
a pulse of light drops from the surface into the water
the camera dives after it through the blue
marine snow streaks past
the pulse streaks down as the seabed comes up out of the dark
the pulse enters the cable on the sand
the camera settles on the hook's first framing of the cable

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Right now, your next video is racing through this cable.

disclaimer: Animations are simplified illustrations, not exact to scale.

references.what: the seabed cable itself drawn big on dark water, a short line of words over it

thumbnail.pattern: the reference sells the cable on the seabed; ours keeps the cable big in 3D with the garden hose beside it and three words asking the question
